en: A monochrome vintage view over a small industrial town seen through slender birch trees in the foreground. In the middle distance are wooden buildings, a few larger masonry houses, factory structures with tall chimneys emitting smoke, timber yards, and railway tracks with freight cars. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Parti af Flen." The town is surrounded by forested hills.
